admin_only: Only an admin can do this.
album_id_invalid: The album id must be a UUID.
album_id_taken: An album with that id already exists.
album_name_taken: An album with that name already exists.
album_name_too_long: The album name is too long.
album_patch_empty: Change the name or the cover.
album_stale: The album changed on the server. Reload and try again.
already_set_up: mosaicWave is already set up. Sign in instead.
asset_not_in_album: That photo is not in this album.
backup_invalid: That is not a usable mosaicWave backup: {{message}}
backup_no_space: Not enough free space for that file: it needs about {{need_mb}} MB and {{free_mb}} MB is free.
backup_not_a_file: That path is not a file: {{path}}
backup_parts_missing: This backup is in {{parts}} parts and part {{missing}} is not here yet. Add the missing part next to the others (or upload it) and try again.
backup_path_required: Enter or browse to the backup zip on the server.
backup_wrong_kind: That is the wrong kind of backup: use a site backup on the admin Backup page and a library backup in Settings.
check_partial: This dump has many zip archives. Check only looks until it finds photos; import will read every archive.
data_dir_env_locked: MOSAICWAVE_DATA_DIR is set, so the folder cannot be changed on the Server page.
data_dir_job_running: Cannot move the library while a job is running.
data_dir_moving: The library is being moved. Try again in a moment.
data_dir_occupied: That destination already has a mosaicWave library.
export_scope: Choose all photos, or albums and photos, not both.
file_forbidden: No permission to read that file: {{message}}
folder_forbidden: No permission to open that folder: {{message}}
folder_not_allowed: That folder belongs to another user's library.
invalid_cursor: The list position is no longer valid. Reload the page.
invalid_role: Role must be admin or member.
invalid_username: Usernames use letters, digits, dot, dash, or underscore (up to 64).
job_cancelled_import: Cancelled: the items imported so far are kept
job_cancelled_library_restore: Cancelled: nothing was changed; the library is as it was
job_cancelled_move: Cancelled: the library stays in its folder
job_cancelled_site_restore: Cancelled: nothing was staged; the library is unchanged
job_cancelled_thumbs: Cancelled: the thumbnails made so far are kept
job_export_done_big: Export {{name}}: {{assets}} files in {{zips}} zip(s) and {{unzipped}} too big to zip
job_library_busy: the library is busy; try again
job_moved: Library moved to the new folder
job_not_active: That import is not the active job.
job_not_running: This job is not running any more.
job_restore_staged: Restore of {{name}} is staged: {{assets}} assets, {{users}} users. Apply it to swap it in.
job_warn_outside_sources: {{count}} source(s) keep their files outside libraries/ and are not in this archive
job_warn_photos_missing: {{count}} photo(s) were not found and are not in the export
job_warn_removed_folder: {{count}} photo(s) belong to a removed folder and are not in the export
job_warn_unreadable: {{count}} file(s) could not be read and are not in the export
job_warn_unsupported_names: {{count}} file(s) with unsupported names were left out
job_warn_vanished_backup: {{count}} file(s) disappeared while the backup ran
library_exists: Each user already has one private library.
library_restoring: Your library is being restored. Try again in a moment.
local_users_unavailable: Local users are not used on QNAP.
loose_media_unexplained: {{name}} is next to the zips but no matching sidecar was found in the archives, so it will not be imported.
maintenance: The server is in maintenance mode. Please try again later.
missing_zip_part: Archive part {{part}} of {{label}} is not on disk and no oversized file named *-{{part}}.* was found. Re-download that zip.
no_takeout_zips: No takeout-*.zip archives in the selected folder. An extracted tree needs a Google Photos folder inside this path (or date folders / photos here).
no_takeout_zips_hint_names: Found zip files with other names: {{other_names}}. mosaicWave looks for takeout-<timestamp>-<part>.zip.
no_takeout_zips_hint_nested: This folder has no takeout-*.zip files. Subfolders that do: {{nested}}. Select that folder.
password_too_short: Password must be at least {{min}} characters.
reads_zips_one: Import reads {{count}} zip archive in place. You do not need to unzip. Oversized videos next to the zips are attached using their sidecars.
reads_zips_other: Import reads {{count}} zip archives in place. You do not need to unzip. Oversized videos next to the zips are attached using their sidecars.
restore_not_staged: No restore is waiting to be applied.
restore_pending: A restored copy is waiting to be applied. Apply or discard it first.
setup_not_available: Local setup is not available on QNAP.
sidecar_without_media_one: {{count}} photo/video sidecar has no matching media file.
sidecar_without_media_other: {{count}} photo/video sidecars have no matching media file.
takeout_no_photos: No photos found. Pick a folder with takeout-*.zip archives or an extracted Google Photos folder.
takeout_not_a_directory: That path is not a folder.
time_zone_data_missing: This server has no time zone data. Ask the administrator to install the tzdata package and restart.
unsupported_media_type: That file type is not a supported photo or video.
upload_folder_only: Uploads only work for folder libraries.
upload_still_running: A device upload is still running. Click Cancel upload, then Import again.
upload_too_large: That file is too large (the limit is {{max_gb}} GB).
zip_has_no_photos: The zip files were opened but no photos or videos were found inside.
zip_unreadable: A zip archive could not be read: {{message}}
